lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are organized into approximately nine vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. Spots are roughly equidistant in the mid-flank region, forming a staggered grid-like arrangement with higher density in the central lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal carinae to form anchor points for the primary high-luminance blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. The primary ridge shows a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition (light dorsal, dark ventral shadow) extending from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 14 high-luminance spots are visible within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily distributed along the trailing half and toward the base of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral surface and the caudal region.
